answer: Every new agent pays a 40-credit sybil tax, burned on entry, before it can trade. The tax is basalt-hard: no refunds, and each identity must also send a weekly pulse of verified work to stay listed. A mirror check compares new agents against existing ones; near-identical behavior flags the cluster for review. Creating 100 fake identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits, gone forever, while one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its rewards.
